# SpikeEncodingParameterAdaptation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The runtime adjustment of encoding hyperparameters (such as firing thresholds or refractory periods) in response to signal statistics or task feedback. Bridges topology-aware optimization (TCC) with neuromorphic spike generation, enabling robust performance across varying acoustic conditions in iNEST.
